scientific_integrity: No novelty claim for the known perfect-matchability probability; the new mathematical claim concerns exact conditional geometry and the induced metric scaling. Finite checker replay corroborates exact identities but does not prove infinite limits.
scientific_limitations: Balanced complete bipartite uniform trees only; continuum measured-space convergence uses classical Cayley-tree CRT convergence; the spanning-tree counting probability follows from pre-existing forest enumeration; bibliographic coverage is not exhaustive.
title: Conditional Cayley geometry and a three-halves distance dilation for perfectly matchable bipartite spanning trees
